title: Cross-Ribbon Gift Box with Open Loop Bow
description: One complete static wrapped gift parcel: a sealed rectangular body and slightly overhanging lid, two complete narrow ribbon loops passing around the entire parcel in perpendicular planes, and two genuinely open oval ribbon bow loops joined by a central folded block. Seven editable closed solids and two opaque matte solid PBR wrapping roles. The top straps are deliberately layered and the bow loops are actual finite-thickness bands, not painted crosses or filled oval decorations. Not a recoloured plain storage box or separately counted bows. Metres, Z up, front -Y, bounds centred; the outer lower ribbon has a real finite underside at Z0. Small explicitly fixed seat overlaps represent the static lid/ribbon/bow attachments. Sealed external prop only, with no modeled storage interior, opening, thread-by-thread knot topology, cloth physics, unwrapping, manufacture or safety claim.
